purpose: Review a finite issuer environmental-operating-externality domain before opening annual, ESG or sustainability reports, table values, source rows, candidate values, comparators or returns, while separating issuer operating disclosures from the terminal environmental-enforcement event family.

repository_evidence.environmental_enforcement_event_family_s: Campaign156 c156_03 rejected environmental-penalty keyword reclassification because it would reopen terminal Campaign113 enforcement sources.
repository_evidence.domain_distinction: Issuer-reported physical emissions, energy use and environmental investment are operating states rather than enforcement-event classifications, but they require a separate exact point-in-time source contract.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: immutable annual, ESG or sustainability report bytes and document identifier for every issuer-period
first public availability timestamp, later revision chain and exact version usable at each signal time
consolidated, parent, subsidiary and facility coverage boundaries, including acquisitions and disposals
greenhouse-gas scope, location-versus-market method, energy and pollutant definitions, units and conversion factors
production, output, revenue or asset denominator identity, scope, units and restatement semantics
environmental capex versus operating expense identity and treatment of government reimbursements
mandatory versus voluntary disclosure, assurance status, missing, undisclosed, not-applicable and genuine-zero semantics
industry-specific taxonomy mappings without using future classifications or post-value peer selection
issuer/security mapping and complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest
deterministic parser and acceptance tests that use no candidate, comparator, price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: annual_greenhouse_gas_emissions_intensity
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Issuer-reported greenhouse-gas externality relative to a stable operating scale.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted contract freezes Scope 1/2 boundaries, market/location method, units, organizational coverage, denominator, assurance, revisions and complete 2019-2023 availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: annual_energy_consumption_or_clean_energy_mix
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Issuer energy dependence or share supplied by lower-carbon sources.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Purchased electricity, fuels, steam and self-generation use inconsistent units and renewable classifications; no point-in-time cross-issuer normalization and full-history contract is accepted.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: annual_environmental_protection_investment_intensity
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Issuer resources committed to pollution control and environmental compliance relative to operating scale.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted source distinguishes environmental capex, operating expense, remediation provisions and reimbursed projects under stable scope, units, revision and denominator rules.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: environmental_penalty_recency_severity_or_keyword_subtype
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign156 c156_03 already closes environmental-keyword reclassification of terminal Campaign113 enforcement records. Changing keyword, severity or event-age rules would be a forbidden source-family rescue.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: emissions_energy_or_environmental_investment_yoy_change_or_target_gap
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Annual improvement, deterioration or distance from a disclosed environmental target.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Level-versus-change, one-year-versus-multi-year and actual-versus-target choices cannot precede exact admission of the underlying physical and investment series.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_environmental_efficiency_peer_residual_or_weighted_score
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A joint environmental efficiency state across emissions, energy and investment relative to peers.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining three unadmitted components or choosing peer groups, residualization, weights, ranks or models would multiply choices before any base series has a stable source contract.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Three distinct operating states remain deferred at source admission; one terminal enforcement route and two premature variant families are closed before values.

next_action: Record all six decisions in an append-only Campaign165 ledger, publish terminal accounting and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain under the next policy.
